_doc: One rubric for proposals, in the same shape as the jobs Weight Lab rubric (dims with key, label, weight, anchors at both ends). Read by scripts/proposal_rank.py and the proposal wiki dial. Anchors approved by Zach 2026-10-15. A measured axis is computed from the files and never hand-scored; a judgment axis is scored by a human in _PROPOSALS/edges.json and stays unscored until then. Difference from the jobs lab: scale_max is 5 here (the decision-geometry axes are five levels) where the lab uses 3, so a reader maps anchor_max to the lab's anchor3 only when scale_max is 3.
anchors_status: APPROVED by Zach 2026-10-15 (chat). Scale 0 to 5 approved the same day. Fibonacci is the zoom step function, not the weight dial.

dial.note: Dial weights stay 0 to 3. The seven Fibonacci steps are for zoom (see the zoom block), not for weights.

dims.label: Recency
dims.how: Days since the proposal date: up to 1 day is 5, 3 is 4, 7 is 3, 14 is 2, 30 is 1, older is 0.

dims.label: Ripple
dims.anchor0: No other decision is recorded as waiting on any of its decisions.
dims.anchor_max: Eight or more other decisions wait on it, directly or through a chain.
dims.how: Count of downstream decisions across _PROPOSALS/edges.json: 0 is 0, 1 is 1, 2 is 2, 3 to 4 is 3, 5 to 7 is 4, 8 or more is 5. Undercounts, because only written-down edges count.

dims.label: Coherence
dims.anchor0: No control names both a case that must fail and a case that must pass.
dims.how: Share of controls with both a known-bad and a known-good case, times 5, rounded. It measures readiness to be tested, not whether the proposal is right.

dims.label: Potency
dims.anchor_max: Approving it unblocks or retires eight or more other pieces of work, or removes a hard-to-reverse risk to the product.
dims.how: Scored by a human in _PROPOSALS/edges.json judgments. Unscored until then.

dims.label: Relevancy
dims.anchor0: Not connected to the goal or next action in the latest handoff.
dims.anchor_max: It is the latest handoff's next action, or a direct blocker of it.
dims.how: Scored by a human in _PROPOSALS/edges.json judgments against the latest handoff block in CLAUDE.md. Unscored until then.

decided.what: Shared scale for proposal axes is 0 to 5, matching the decision-geometry axes
The five axis anchors in this file
Fibonacci steps (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21) are the step function for zoom

zoom.meaning: Fibonacci step function for zoom: level k shows at most steps[k-1] items per view, never more items than have evidence behind them. Seven levels, matching the HUD fathoms F1 to F7.
rules: Each deeper level must add at least one new item that has provenance, or it is not a zoom, it is scroll.
Where evidence is thin the view shows fewer items and says so (grain), never invented detail.
A level that would need more than 21 items is split into child views.
zoom.status: APPROVED by Zach 2026-10-15 (chat) as the role of Fibonacci; the effect on comprehension is untested.
